concerns.text: T006 runs 'the full matrix (5 seeds × 3 α × 5 ε)' but the 5 ε values are never enumerated in spec, plan, or tasks. The experimental matrix FR-004/FR-003 depends on is unimplementable as written; the task silently underspecifies rather than preserves the plan's '5 ε values (including ε = ∞ baseline)'.

T008 omits the plan's mandated Bonferroni correction ('Bonferroni correction if > 5 simultaneous tests', α_adj = 0.05/15). A dropped acceptance criterion from the Statistical Analysis Plan; Constitution Principle VII requires corrected p-values.

Plan T018c mandates retry logic ('retries failed seeds up to 3 attempts to guarantee 5 successful runs'). T006's verification demands 'exactly 5 successful runs per (α, ε)' but the task drops the retry mechanism, silently weakening the FR-004 guarantee.

Plan states time-limited runs 'are excluded from ALL downstream statistical analyses (paired t-tests, LMM, filtering)'. T007 only excludes is_time_limited=True 'for convergence metrics' (filtered_time.csv); T008's paired t-tests/LMM run on filtered_data.csv, which does not exclude time-limited runs. Semantic weakening of the plan's bias-avoidance rule.

T010 requires 'convergence rounds per configuration' in summary.csv, but no task implements the plan's T025 convergence detection (rounds_to_80, first round where global_accuracy ≥ 0.80). The deliverable is unverifiable because its computation was dropped.

T004 says 'bottom entropy percentile' without naming the percentile or its reference. Plan's Minority Definition uses the sanctioned [deferred] marker, but the task must at least state the metric and reference (e.g. 'bottom [deferred] percentile of within-partition entropy distribution') to preserve Constitution Principle VI's testability.

Plan's T032 (unit/integration tests: partition reproducibility, DP-vs-non-DP logging, timeout flagging, utility-collapse filter) and the plan's Testing context ('pytest unit & integration') have no corresponding task. Dropped plan deliverable — either add a testing task or document the staging explicitly.
